examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: فكرة كويسة، انا خرجت مع اصحابي امبارح وتعبان.
examples.english: Good idea, I went out with my friends yesterday and I am tired.
examples.transliteration: Fekra kwayesa, ana kharagt ma a ashabi embareh wa taaban.

examples.arabic: انا كنت مبسوط جدا وقلت انا موافق على الفكرة دي
examples.english: I was very happy and said I agree with this idea.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot gedan wa olt ana mowafeq ala el fekra di.

examples.arabic: بابا قال فكرة حلوة أوي ونضحك كلنا
examples.english: Dad said 'very good idea' and we all laughed.
examples.transliteration: Baba 'al fekra Helwa 'awi w neDhak kollena.

examples.english: This is a beautiful idea. I am happy.

examples.arabic: أنا قلت فكرة كويسة عايزين نروح فين
examples.english: I said: 'Good idea! Where do we want to go?'
